# David’s favorite-folder launcher — installation handoff

## What this adds
- **Favorite folders**, **New session**, and **Resume** buttons in David’s bot channel.
- A computer label from David’s bot name; optional `CCDB_COMPUTER_NAME` can override it.
- Personal saved favorites for each operator, kept on this computer.
- New threads bound to the selected Windows folder; Resume opens the original thread.
- No terminal commands for ordinary use and no model calls from the buttons themselves.

## Prompt for David’s current session
Apply this handoff after finishing your API authentication fix; implement and test it yourself, preserve your existing changes, credentials, personal instructions and model settings, commit locally, then activate when all sessions are idle and post the real launcher link with your verification results.

## Installation work for the agent
This is an additive launcher feature, not a replacement installation or a change to permission mode.
- Inspect `C:\Users\david\ccdb\bridge`, its status, and the real running instance before editing; preserve your authentication fix and every unrelated change.
- Decode the embedded gzip/base64 JSON below, verify its SHA-256, inspect the three text files, and install them at the listed relative paths; if any already exist with different content, merge deliberately rather than overwriting.
- The payload uses only existing discord.py and settings/session repository APIs; no new dependencies.
- In `claude_discord/setup.py`, import `ProjectLauncherCog` from `.cogs.project_launcher` alongside other Cog imports.
- Inside the existing `if _all_channel_ids:` block, immediately after `_primary_channel_id` is selected, register it exactly once with:

```python
await bot.add_cog(ProjectLauncherCog(
    bot, session_repo, settings_repo, chat_cog,
    channel_id=_primary_channel_id,
    channel_ids=_all_channel_ids,
    working_dir=runner.working_dir,
))
```

- Add `"launcher": "📌 Session"` to `_HELP_CATEGORY` in `claude_discord/cogs/claude_chat.py` so `/help` includes the new command.
- Export `ProjectLauncherCog` in both package `__init__.py` files alongside other Cogs and add it to their `__all__` lists.
- Verify `chat_cog._allowed_user_ids` includes the already-authorized operators and shared thread membership is configured; preserve those settings, do not invent new IDs or credentials.
- Existing `CCDB_PROJECT_ROOTS` is respected; if unset, the runner’s working folder supplies suggestions automatically, so no folder configuration is mandatory.
- Run the launcher and setup tests, lint, formatting, type checking, and the applicable full test suite; perform the repository security review. Run no paid model tests merely to check buttons.
- The default panel is created automatically on startup and reused on reconnect. Its message ID and favorites use the existing settings database, with no schema changes.
- Use David’s existing supervisor/recovery mechanism at an idle boundary. Do not kill the active setup turn or any other agent session; arrange the restart after the receipt is delivered if necessary.
- Verify the posted panel has all three buttons, only authorized operators can act, folders are selected on David’s computer, and Resume hides deleted threads. Report separately which parts were automated checks and which require a human click.
- Commit only these changes locally; leave the existing API fix in its own commit and do not push.
